reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin packages by presenting tokens, projected appreciation, interest from holding, and trading for euros as potential financial benefits. It also offers commissions for sharing the opportunity, while noting that the values, interest, and commissions are only illustrations or projections and were not established as realized.

citations.quote: you can buy a start up pack or trade a pack for 500 Euro with that you get a training and you get tokens
And with these tokens, you can mine 1-Coins!
That means that will give you a 1981 Euro value.
you are rewarded Commission every time you share this opportunity with others

opening.argument: The presentation explicitly says income is not guaranteed and that success or failure depends on each person's own skills and efforts. It identifies the illustrated income as results of retail sales of education packages and says the figures are for illustration only. Its projections are also labeled predictions rather than a financial forecast. Those qualifications matter: the examples are presented as conditional illustrations, not promised outcomes, and the video does not establish that a viewer will earn a particular return.

citations.quote: there are no guarantees regarding income the success or failure of each person, like any other business, depends on the person, the skills and personal efforts.
retail sales of education packages of OneCoin. And the incomes discussed in the next few slides are for illustration purposes only.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The package calculations and projected growth are evidence of how the presenter describes the offer, but they do not override the express qualification that income is not guaranteed and the examples are illustrative. The cited commission concerns a separately described active option; the presentation distinguishes it from the passive method and says introducing others is not required for that method.

citations.quote: will you require to introduce anybody else to achieve this no and you will not this is the passive way of investing in one coin
there is an active way of benefitting from Onecoin – and this is that you are rewarded Commission every time you share this opportunity with others

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not change what the presentation is selling: it connects paid packages to tokens that can be used to mine OneCoins, then calculates substantial euro values from those tokens. Calling the calculations illustrative still leaves them serving as inducements, alongside projections and the statement that coins can be kept for interest or traded for euros.

citations.quote: you can buy a start up pack or trade a pack for 500 Euro with that you get a training and you get tokens
And with these tokens, you can mine 1-Coins!
That means that will give you a 1981 Euro value.
you even get 10% interest a year and 12% over two years.

opening.argument: The video presents itself as an independent member training presentation and walks through concepts it says are part of financial education: digital currency, split strategies, tokens, and mining. It describes a practical demonstration of that education and explains the calculations used to convert tokens by a stated difficulty factor. The central format is an explanation of a course and its mechanics, rather than a report of a viewer's realized results. The presenter also says the short training is only a tiny fraction of the education available in the package.

citations.quote: You have learned that just about Digital Currency, about Split Strategies and about mining
this training explained to you how you simply paid for financial education products and tokens that you could use to mine won coins.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that the presentation explains mining and financial concepts supports the educational framing. The prosecution's examples describe package terms and projected illustrations within that explanation; they do not establish that the video reports actual outcomes or makes a guaranteed promise. The disclaimer expressly calls the income examples illustrative.

citations.quote: the incomes discussed in the next few slides are for illustration purposes only

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational format is also the sales pitch: the explanation repeatedly directs viewers to buy packages, says those packages include tokens, and demonstrates how tokens produce mined coins and a larger claimed euro value. Calling the material training does not make that paid mining-return mechanism merely an operational tutorial.

citations.quote: you can buy a start up pack or trade a pack for 500 Euro with that you get a training and you get tokens
And with these tokens, you can mine 1-Coins!
That means that will give you a 1981 Euro value.

opening.argument: The offer is described as a purchase of education packages that provide training and tokens, with different package prices and token quantities. The speaker calls the tokens useful for mining and explains the calculation, but the material does not show a viewer making a payment, a completed withdrawal, or an actual realized return. It also says introducing other people is not required for the passive method; commissions are presented separately as an active way of benefiting. On the evidence shown, this can be read as a product and service promotion with optional referral activity, not proof of a required recruitment scheme or guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: you can buy a start up pack or trade a pack for 500 Euro with that you get a training and you get tokens
will you require to introduce anybody else to achieve this no and you will not this is the passive way of investing in one coin
However, there is an active way of benefitting from Onecoin – and this is that you are rewarded Commission every time you share this opportunity with others.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The quoted package terms and token calculations establish what is being offered, not that the offer is fraudulent. The video does not show an actual payout or withdrawal, and the commission passage describes a separate active option rather than a requirement for the passive method. The stated disclaimer also cautions that the income examples are not guaranteed.

citations.quote: there are no guarantees regarding income
you will not this is the passive way of investing in one coin

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a depicted payment or withdrawal does not erase the explicit solicitation: viewers are told to buy packages, receive tokens, and use them to mine coins, with illustrative calculations presenting euro values. The video further describes holding coins for interest and trading them for euros. These are represented as benefits tied to the paid package, even if recruitment is not required and returns are disclaimed.
